keyEvents.text: Vasilios Zagaritis (Heerenveen) is shown the yellow card.
Jorg Schreuders (Groningen) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Márk Csinger (Groningen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Groningen 0, Heerenveen 1. Dylan Vente (Heerenveen) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Groningen 1, Heerenveen 1. Thom van Bergen (Groningen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pelle Clement.
Dylan Vente (Heerenveen) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Dirk Proper replaces Nolhan Courtens.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Mees Hilgers replaces Sam Kersten.
Goal! Groningen 1, Heerenveen 2. Dylan Vente (Heerenveen) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jacob Trenskow with a cross.
Substitution, Groningen. Tyrique Mercera replaces David van der Werff.
Substitution, Groningen. Ryan Metu replaces Pelle Clement.
Substitution, Groningen. Oskar Zawada replaces Jacob Ondrejka.
Goal! Groningen 1, Heerenveen 3. Dirk Proper (Heerenveen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ringo Meerveld.
Substitution, Heerenveen. Maxence Rivera replaces Ringo Meerveld.
Substitution, Groningen. Nils Eggens replaces Brynjólfur Willumsson.
Substitution, Groningen. Tygo Land replaces Tika de Jonge.
